title: Nine Pots and One Kiln
subtitle: 艺术与美术 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术与美术（文学艺术与体育·绘画与造型艺术）
meta: 主题语境：艺术与美术（文学艺术与体育·绘画与造型艺术）　|　核心词汇：art　|　正文 322 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 art 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 my aunt took up ① an art she could not explain, which turned out to be pots. The ② art, meaning the skill and not the pots, took nine years and one kiln; an art, my grandmother said, is a job that has learned to be useless on purpose. She said the uselessness was the part the village could not forgive.

Every ③ art in that house was learned at a kitchen table, and none of it was written down. Their ④ art — the one the village called a hobby — paid for nothing and cost nine pounds a month; an art, my father said, is the only work people praise by not buying. He said he had never worked out whether that was cruelty or respect.

My uncle said ⑤ art was a word for people who cannot finish anything, and my aunt said he had described himself. The ⑥ art, meaning the idea and not the pots or the skill, is nine parts looking and one part luck, my mother said; an art, she said, is the only thing you can practise for years and still fail at on a Tuesday. She said the failing is what makes it a practice.

By 1975 the ⑦ art school had taken her twice and refused her once, and she said the refusing was the teaching. The ⑧ art of it, she told me in 1976, is knowing when to stop; an art, my father said, is the only skill whose last step is always refusal. He said most people never reach the last step.

The  art I remember is the pot with the blue rim, which she threw nine times and kept once. An  art, she said in 1981, is the only thing a person can be good at and poor from; every art, she said, is a way of wasting time so beautifully that nobody calls it waste. She said the village called it something else.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 艺术；技艺（一门具体的手艺）
B. n. 技艺；手艺（指那门本事，与成品相对）
D. 固定搭配：take up an art 开始学一门手艺
E. n. 艺术（抽象概念；泛指）
F. n. 艺术（家里的、村里人说的那种）
G. n. 艺术（抽象总称）
H. 固定搭配：the art of something ……的诀窍、技艺

items.q: an art she could not explain
The art, meaning the skill and not the pots
art was a word for people who cannot finish anything

answers.why: take up an art 意为“开始学一门手艺”，1966 年姑姑学了一门她说不清楚的手艺，后来发现是做陶罐。
art 指“那门本事、技艺”，与成品陶罐相对，这门手艺花了九年和一座窑。
art 意为“一门手艺”，那屋里每一门手艺都是在餐桌上学会的，没有一门写下来过。
art 指家里的、村里人说的那种手艺，村里人管它叫“爱好”，它不挣钱，每月倒花九镑。
art 为抽象概念，泛指“艺术”，叔叔说艺术是给什么事也做不完的人准备的一个词。
art 为抽象总称，指“这个念头”，既不是罐子也不是手艺，是九分观察加一分运气。
art 作定语，art school 意为“美术学校、艺术学校”，到 1975 年那所学校录取过她两次、拒绝过她一次。
the art of something 意为“……的诀窍”，1976 年她告诉我，做这事的诀窍是知道什么时候停手。
